definitions.explanation: Unimportant details far from the heart of a matter. A four-character idiom used to criticize getting caught up in side issues.

examples.japanese: {枝葉末節|しようまっせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧。
examples.english: To get hung up on trivial details.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{枝葉末節|しようまっせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: That is only a minor point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{枝葉末節|しようまっせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、⟦{肝心|かんじん}→肝心：21541_kanjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}まなかった→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The meeting argued over nothing but minor points, and the budget, which was what mattered, got nowhere.

notes:
{枝葉|しよう} (branches and leaves) + {末節|まっせつ} (the far ends of the joints): the parts farthest from the trunk. Inside this idiom the first two kanji take their on-readings (shi-you), not the everyday reading eda-ha.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {枝葉末節|しようまっせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧ / とらわれる: to get caught up in trivia
- {枝葉末節|しようまっせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{省|はぶ}く→省く：02398_habuku⟧: to leave out the details

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{枝葉|えだは}→枝葉：22248_edaha⟧: branches and leaves; side issues — the everyday word
- ⟦{本質|ほんしつ}→本質：04810_honshitsu⟧: the essence — the opposite
